import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    return (params[0] + params[1]*P*np.log(P) + params[2]*t*np.sqrt(P) + params[3]*P
            + params[4]*P**2 + params[5]*t + params[6]*P**3 + params[7]*np.exp(-P))
